page.overview:
Who is Baby Cinnamon Bun?

Baby Cinnamon Bun is a minor character in the episode "The Winter King". He is an alternate version of the Cinnamon Bun from the main universe. He lives in a world where everyone is a baby.

He first appears in "The Winter King", when Fionna, Cake, and Simon Petrikov visit his universe. He is seen sitting idly, before Baby Finn and Baby Jake are brought near him. Soon Finn got a hold of a rattle and hit him in the head, causing him to cry.
